user.title: Home Assistant Cleanup
user.description: Adds the Cleanup panel to the sidebar. It finds outliers in recorded sensor values and lets you fix or delete them, and it backs up and restores the recorder database.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Assistant Cleanup is already set up.

scan.name: Scan for outliers
scan.description: Checks all numeric entities in the recorder for outliers, stores the result for the Cleanup panel and sends a notification.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Send the result as a notification (settings of the Cleanup panel).

days.name: Period
days.description: Days to check. Default: the period set for the automatic scan.
